svg.title: Terraforming Mars setup
svg.desc: The game board with the oxygen marker on 0 percent, the temperature marker on minus 30 degrees, the 9 ocean tiles stacked on their space, and every terraform rating marker on 20. Beside it are the project deck, the discard space, the tile supply, and the resource cubes. Below are two player boards with production at 1 on all six tracks.

g.text: Edge: TR track. All players on 20, generation on 1
Production starts at 1 on all six tracks. Corporate Era cards stay in the box.
